    end

        return store:UpdateAsync(key,function(original,keyInfo)
            local current=if original==nil then Store.blank() else original
            if not Store.validate(current) or current.revision>maxRevision
                or current.revision<expectedRevision then return nil end
            local nextRecord
            if current.revision~=expectedRevision then

                -- A missing/deleted record cannot confirm an older snapshot.
                nextRecord=original

                if current.revision>=maxRevision then return nil end
                nextRecord=Store.equipTransition(current,item)
                if nextRecord==nil then return nil end
                -- A fresh same-item choice is also a new confirmed intent.
                -- A stale same-item retry above never increments again.
